review: 701.50f-1: the not_my_creature variant changed Glorious Purpose's controller, which tests the trigger's 'you control' condition rather than 701.50f; replaced it with nothing_to_discard (draw and discard both impossible, the connive still counts) and noted that 701.50f has no does_not_fire branch.

scenarios.title: Connive draws a card then discards a card, adding a counter only if the discard is nonland

setup.notes: Echo Inspector is the only card in A's hand; once it is cast, the card A draws is the only card A can discard. Library lists are top first; cards below the listed ones are irrelevant Forests.

decisions: A casts Echo Inspector, tapping four Islands.
Both players pass; Echo Inspector resolves and its enters trigger goes on the stack.
Both players pass; the trigger resolves: Echo Inspector connives. A draws Grizzly Bears and discards it.

variants.label: nonland_discard
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears moves from the library to the hand to A's graveyard. Echo Inspector gets one +1/+1 counter and is a 3/4 flier. A's hand is empty.

variants.label: land_discard
variants.delta: The top card of A's library is Forest instead of Grizzly Bears.
variants.expected: Forest moves from the library to the hand to A's graveyard. Echo Inspector gets no counter and is a 2/3 flier. A's hand is empty.

scenarios.title: A permanent that left the battlefield still connives using last known information

setup.notes: Ledger Shredder (1/3 flier) triggers whenever a player casts their second spell each turn; nothing has been cast this turn. Library lists are top first; cards below the listed ones are irrelevant Forests.

decisions: A casts Shock targeting B, tapping a Mountain; both players pass and it resolves (B 18).
A casts Shock targeting B, tapping the other Mountain. Ledger Shredder's trigger goes on the stack above it.
B responds by casting Lightning Bolt targeting Ledger Shredder, tapping B's Mountain.
All players pass until everything resolves, the trigger resolving before the second Shock: Ledger Shredder connives, A draws Grizzly Bears and discards it.

variants.label: shredder_dies_in_response
variants.expected: Lightning Bolt deals 3 damage and Ledger Shredder dies, so it is in A's graveyard when its trigger resolves. The trigger still resolves with Ledger Shredder's last known information: A draws Grizzly Bears and discards it (graveyard), and no counter is placed because Ledger Shredder is not on the battlefield. B's life is 16 after the second Shock.

variants.label: no_response
variants.delta: B does not cast Lightning Bolt.
variants.expected: Ledger Shredder stays on the battlefield. It connives: A draws Grizzly Bears and discards it, and Ledger Shredder gets a +1/+1 counter and is a 2/4 flier. B's life is 16 after the second Shock.

scenarios.forge_notes: ConniveEffect resolves against the trigger's host card; it checks that the card is still on the battlefield with the same timestamp before adding counters. Whether Forge keeps A drawing and discarding for a card in the graveyard needs checking when the scenario is played.

scenarios.title: Permanents instructed to connive together connive one at a time

setup.notes: Both of A's creatures are controlled by A, who chooses the order. Change of Plans' optional phasing is declined. Library lists are top first; cards below the listed ones are irrelevant Forests.

decisions: A casts Change of Plans with X = 2, tapping four Islands, targeting Grizzly Bears and Runeclaw Bear.
Both players pass; Change of Plans resolves. A chooses Grizzly Bears to connive first.
Grizzly Bears connives: A draws Hill Giant and discards it. Then Runeclaw Bear connives: A draws Forest and discards it.
A chooses not to phase out either creature.

variants.label: bears_first
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears draws and discards Hill Giant (nonland) and gets a +1/+1 counter, a 3/3. Then Runeclaw Bear draws and discards Forest and gets no counter, a 2/2. Hill Giant and Forest are in A's graveyard; A's hand is empty.

variants.label: runeclaw_first
variants.delta: A chooses Runeclaw Bear to connive first.
variants.expected: Runeclaw Bear draws and discards Hill Giant and gets a +1/+1 counter, a 3/3. Then Grizzly Bears draws and discards Forest and gets no counter, a 2/2.

variants.label: single_conniver
variants.delta: X = 1 and Grizzly Bears is the only target.
variants.expected: Only one permanent connives, so there is no ordering. Grizzly Bears draws and discards Hill Giant and is a 3/3. Forest stays on top of A's library.

scenarios.forge_notes: Only the same-controller part of 701.50c is reachable: no Forge card makes permanents of both players connive at the same time, so the APNAP ordering between players is not illustrated.

scenarios.title: Connive N draws N, discards N and adds a counter per nonland card discarded

setup.notes: A's hand is empty, so the cards A draws are the only cards A can discard. Library lists are top first; cards below the listed ones are irrelevant Forests.

decisions: A attacks B with Grizzly Bears (equipped with Mask of the Schemer). B has no blockers.
Combat damage is dealt: Grizzly Bears deals 2 damage to B and Mask of the Schemer's trigger resolves: Grizzly Bears connives 2.
A draws Hill Giant and Forest and discards both.

variants.label: one_nonland
variants.expected: B's life is 18. A draws two cards and discards two: Hill Giant and Forest are in A's graveyard and A's hand is empty. One of the two discarded cards is nonland, so Grizzly Bears gets one +1/+1 counter and is a 3/3.

variants.label: two_lands
variants.delta: The top two cards of A's library are Forest and Island.
variants.expected: B's life is 18. Forest and Island are drawn and discarded, A's hand is empty, and Grizzly Bears gets no counter and stays a 2/2.

scenarios.title: Connive 0 is no event, so connive triggers do not fire

setup.notes: No creature has died this turn. Glorious Purpose: whenever a creature you control connives, put a +1/+1 counter on it and a plan counter on Glorious Purpose. Library lists are top first; cards below the listed ones are irrelevant Forests.

decisions: A activates Spymaster's Vault ({B}, {T}, tapping the Swamp) targeting Grizzly Bears.
Both players pass; the ability resolves: Grizzly Bears connives X, where X is the number of creatures that died this turn.

variants.label: x_zero
variants.expected: X is 0, so Grizzly Bears connives 0: no connive event occurs. A draws and discards nothing (Shock stays in hand, Forest stays on top of the library), Glorious Purpose does not trigger, Grizzly Bears has no counter and is a 2/2, and Glorious Purpose has no plan counter.

variants.label: x_one
variants.delta: Before activating the Vault, A casts Shock (tapping the Mountain) targeting B's Runeclaw Bear, which dies.
variants.expected: X is 1, so Grizzly Bears connives 1: A draws Forest and discards it (the only card in hand), and the connives trigger fires. Glorious Purpose puts a +1/+1 counter on Grizzly Bears (3/3) and a plan counter on itself.

scenarios.forge_notes: ConniveEffect has no zero-count check: it runs the Connives trigger even when ConniveNum is 0, so Forge would fire Glorious Purpose in the x_zero variant. The expected text follows 701.50e.

scenarios.title: A permanent connives, firing connive triggers, even if drawing is impossible

setup.notes: A has already drawn a card this turn in the draw step. Spirit of the Labyrinth: each player can't draw more than one card each turn. Library lists are top first; cards below the listed ones are irrelevant Forests.

decisions: A casts Echo Inspector, tapping four Islands.
Both players pass; Echo Inspector resolves and its enters trigger goes on the stack.
Both players pass; the trigger resolves: Echo Inspector connives. A cannot draw, and discards Grizzly Bears.
Glorious Purpose's connives trigger resolves.

variants.label: draw_impossible
variants.expected: No card is drawn: Forest stays on top of A's library. Grizzly Bears (nonland) is discarded, so Echo Inspector gets a counter. Echo Inspector still connived, so Glorious Purpose triggers: Echo Inspector gets a second +1/+1 counter (4/5) and Glorious Purpose gets a plan counter.

variants.label: draw_possible
variants.delta: B controls no Spirit of the Labyrinth.
variants.expected: A draws Forest, then discards Grizzly Bears; Forest stays in A's hand. Echo Inspector gets one counter from the discard and one from Glorious Purpose (4/5), and Glorious Purpose gets a plan counter.

variants.label: nothing_to_discard
variants.delta: A's hand holds only Echo Inspector, so after it is cast A has no card to discard.
variants.expected: No card is drawn and none is discarded, so the connive itself adds no counter. Echo Inspector still connived, so Glorious Purpose triggers: Echo Inspector gets one +1/+1 counter (3/4) and Glorious Purpose gets a plan counter.

scenarios.forge_notes: 701.50f has no does_not_fire branch: a connive instruction with N of at least 1 always counts as conniving. The non-event case is connive 0, covered by 701.50e-1.
